cohort: The study included 53,522 viable births (>=22 weeks of amenorrhea) from all four perinatal facilities in French Guiana between 2014 and 2020.
finding: The Afro-Caribbean population has a higher risk of preeclampsia than the white population, and residents of towns in western French Guiana also show an increased risk, with preeclampsia being a major cause of preterm birth.
